1479-2841-3897-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-1976-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

728-1086-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1086-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

252-4231-5295-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5295-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

225-851-1308-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3490-5231-6824-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6824-7818.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7296-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Omni-Changeling each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

341-1090-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3240-5256-5477-6462.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token, a 1/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2173-2469-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-2469-4446-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2724-3217-4499.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Emiel the Blessed. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2988-4740-7423.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2988-4740-7423.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-2079-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7153.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3025-4681-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2653-2692-2893-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4195-4574-4708-6766.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1315-3234-3293-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-5256.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-5256.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

874-1170-2478-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
874-1170-2478-6862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-2478-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4559-4740-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-5670-6291.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure and Thopter, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4559-4740-5670-6291.notes: Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1580-4647-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

3525-4758-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Crossroads Candleguide.
3525-4758-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-4758-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

195-3371-5149-5385.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Power Artifact attached to Codie.
Any additional nonpermanent card in hand with mana to cast it.
195-3371-5149-5385.description:
Cast Aura Finesse by paying {U}, attaching Power Artifact to Codie and drawing a card.
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting Codie.
Holding priority, activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve Chain Stasis, untapping Codie and causing you to pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis, with the copy targeting Codie.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may choose not to copy Chain Stasis and cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
195-3371-5149-5385.notes: Step 1 is necessary because you cannot cast Power Artifact once Codie is on the battlefield.

855-1491-2757-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
855-1491-2757-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

862-2438-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2527-3143-3464-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-4050.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout, adding one mana of any color.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

539-5089-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
539-5089-5175.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Caged Sun to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat step 3.
As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.

232-3045-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R} that can only be spent as though it were colorless mana due to Celestial Dawn.
Repeat.

914-1927-3094-3383.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1927-3094-3383.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Distorting Wake by paying {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Distorting Wake.
Resolve the copy of Distorting Wake, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{R}.
Cast Lithoform Engine by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 5.

232-586-1980-2239-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Ardent Elementalist, Priest of Gix, and Priest of Urabrask enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1424-3957-4210.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
1424-3957-4210.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Pious Evangel and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
